consequence.statement: A new field was added to the schema; the evidence states no operational consequence if the operator does nothing.

original.statement: A new optional field spec.solver.dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID was added to the acme.cert-manager.io/v1 Challenge CRD schema.

decision.reason: The CRD artifacts show spec.solver.dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID only in the v1.17.0 Challenge schema [ev-60054fcf0986] and not in v1.16.0 [ev-84061d76ea1b]. A deterministic check (semvalidate.canonical, rule added/none) confirmed that adding the field has no consequence for existing environments. Nothing in the evidence says anything is rejected, ignored or broken. So "none", which makes it informational, is the supported answer.
